rule.title: Real estate tax counts only if paid in 2025 and assessed before 2026

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this real estate tax NOT paid to the taxing authority in 2025, or a prepayment of a tax assessed for 2026 or later (or refunded or rebated in 2025)?

citation.wording: Only taxes paid in 2025 and assessed prior to 2026 can be deducted for 2025.

rule.open_point: A PARTIAL refund or rebate reduces the deduction by its amount; no operator reduces a figure by an answered amount, so only a wholly refunded tax is answered here.
